d:
The 76ers defeated the Magic, 121-116 tonight in Orlando. Joel Embiid contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 7 assists 6 rebounds and 2 steals, with VJ Edgecombe of the 76ers adding an additional 24 points (8-15 FG, 4-9 3P) in the game. Franz Wagner finished with a team-high 27 points along with 11 assists for the Magic in the losing effort. The 76ers improve their record to 13-3 with the win, while the Magic fall to 6-8 for the season.
